about.description:
IMAS-Core is part of the Integrated Modelling and Analysis Suite at ITER.
It provides a low-level library to read and write MDSplus ([Introduction](https://www.mdsplus.org/index.php/Introduction))
and HDF5 ([HDF5](https://www.hdfgroup.org/solutions/hdf5/)) formats.
It also supports reading and writing [FlexBuffers](https://flatbuffers.dev/flexbuffers/).
For debugging purposes, it allows writing ASCII files.
Notably, for keeping data in-memory when exchanging data between physics codes, it supports writing into memory.
The IMAS-Core library includes Python bindings, making it useful for working with Python.
It can be installed on different operating systems, including macOS and Windows.
IMAS-Core is a versatile library that helps users write fusion data in a standard format used by various users and facilitates easy data exchange.
Most of the code is written in C++, with wrappers on existing libraries for HDF5, MDSplus, and FlexBuffers.
about.summary: The IMAS Access Layer core library

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "5.7.1"

recipe:
  name: imas-core
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/iterorganization/IMAS-Core/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: eec5fdd4b9db219f05d54025776a3ce57a32c65cced463ab499de1c04a6f02d9
    patches:
      - patches/change-python-init.patch
      - patches/hdf5-global-target-fallback.patch

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  # Core library
  - package:
      name: libimas-core
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      script:
        - if: unix
          then: scripts/build_core.sh
        - if: win
          then: scripts/build_core.bat
      files:
        exclude:
          - ${{ "Library/" if win }}share/common/
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - git
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
      host:
        - libxml2-devel >=2.15
        - zlib
        - libboost-devel >=1.88
        - hdf5
        - uda-cpp >=2.9.3
        # TODO: enable once MDSplus build is available
        # - if: linux
        #   then:
        #     - mdsplus
        - if: win
          then:
            - pthreads-win32
            - dlfcn-win32
      run:
        - if: win
          then:
            - pthreads-win32
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libimas-core", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - imas_print_version

  # Python bindings
  - package:
      name: imas-core
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      script:
        - if: unix
          then: scripts/build_py.sh
        - if: win
          then: scripts/build_py.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - git
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - cython
            - cython-cmake
            - scikit-build-core
      host:
        - libimas-core
        - pip
        - python
        - numpy
        - cython
        - cython-cmake
        - scikit-build-core
        - setuptools-scm
        - libboost-devel >=1.88
      run:
        - python
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("imas-core", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - libboost-devel
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - imas_core
          pip_check: true
      - script:
          - pytest
        files:
          source:
            - python/tests/
            - pyproject.toml
        requirements:
          run:
            - pytest
